name: Yukiyanagi Kakeru
source: A teacher at Hakuou Academy, his area of speciality is history. His cute appearance makes him a particular hit amongst female students, but he's also popular with the male students because of his friendly, laidback and warm demeanour. Kakeru is often seen with a smile. He seems to have his head in the clouds, but Kakeru is quite sharp.
